title: Manufacturing

mods.html: Manufacturing

Discover exciting opportunities in the dynamic world of manufacturing. Explore roles that shape industries, from production and operations to quality assurance and supply chain management. Whether you are an experienced professional or entering the field, our manufacturing jobs span a spectrum of expertise. Join us in building the future, where innovation meets precision, and your skills contribute to the creation of high-quality products. Explore diverse career paths within our manufacturing sector and be a part of a team that values excellence, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Find your ideal manufacturing job and advance your career with us.
Manufacturing Engineer/Supervisor/ Technician (Across USA)

Job description

Responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing manufacturing processes. Supervises technicians, ensures efficiency, and maintains quality in production processes.
Product/New Product Engineer/Designer (Across USA)

Job description

Focuses on designing and developing new products. Works closely with manufacturing teams to ensure feasible and efficient production. Involves in product testing and iteration.
Production Manager/Supervisor (Across USA)

Job description

Oversees the production process in a manufacturing setting. Manages staff, schedules work, and ensures product quality and timely delivery.
Quality Control/Quality Assurance Engineer/Supervisor (Across USA)

Job description

Ensures the quality of products in manufacturing. Develops quality standards, oversees testing, and identifies areas for improvement in production processes.
Supply Chain Manager (Across USA)

Job description

Manages the end-to-end supply chain process in manufacturing. Coordinates with suppliers, oversees logistics, and ensures efficient inventory management.
Purchaser/Buyer/ Purchasing Agent (Across USA)

Job description

Responsible for purchasing materials and supplies needed for manufacturing. Negotiates with suppliers, evaluates quality and cost, and maintains inventory levels.
Process Engineer (Across USA)

Job description

Designs and optimizes manufacturing processes for efficiency and quality. Develops new process strategies and troubleshoots existing production issues.
Controls Engineer (Across USA)

Job description

Specializes in designing and maintaining control systems in manufacturing. Ensures machinery operates efficiently and safely.
Production/Plant Manager/Supervisor (Across USA)

Job description

Manages the overall operations of a manufacturing plant or production facility. Oversees staff, production schedules, and ensures compliance with safety standards.
Industrial Engineer/Supervisor/ Technician (Across USA)

Job description

Focuses on optimizing manufacturing processes for increased efficiency and reduced waste. Analyzes production workflows and implements improvements.
Product Design/Design Engineer (Across USA)

Job description

Involved in the conceptualization and design of new products. Works closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to create viable product designs.
Maintenance/EHS/Safety Manager/Coordinator (Across USA)

Job description

Oversees maintenance of equipment and facilities in a manufacturing setting.
